integrity: Support classes and disjointness adjacency are derived directly from coordinatewise multiplication. A two-stage forcing proof handles singleton classes created by binary factors, the Boolean quotient matrix is unimodular, and an exact subset-product inversion reconstructs all field orders.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes at least one binary and at least one nonbinary field factor.
The all-binary product is excluded because singleton support classes can obstruct the factorization.
The all-nonbinary regime has no singleton support classes and is not the boundary treated here.
Minimum rank is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
Ring reconstruction is asserted only within finite products of fields.
title: Zero forcing polynomials recognize mixed finite-field zero-divisor graphs
